crossRefs.note: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will…
then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy…
Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has…
then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy…
You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and…
behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says Yahweh, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king…
Let the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people…
It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save…

translations.web: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
translations.bsb: You will become an object of horror, scorn, and ridicule among all the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead
translations.asv: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all the peoples whither Jehovah shall lead thee away.
